_comment: Sidecar-only, ADDITIVE OWL axiom declarations. The framework bundle format carries constraints (endpoint matrix); this file carries the logical axioms it does not. NOTE: OWL 2 DL forbids non-simple (transitive) properties in Irreflexive/Asymmetric/Disjoint object property axioms, so the multi-hop demonstration uses transitive ENTAILMENT (a legal construct) rather than a self-loop.
